targetText: Man is to have the opportunity to develop himself to the full : that should be the purpose of all human socialisation, which means that he must not be fettered to the soil on which he has been placed by accident of birth.
summary: Bebel depicts everyday life in socialist society: public kitchens, mechanized central laundries, and communal dining halls liberate women from household drudgery, enabling complete individual freedom, travel, intellectual growth, and harmonious social life.
